L7: In connection with the Annual Report of Starbucks Corporation (“Starbucks”) on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 29, 2024, as filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on November 20, 2024 (the “Report”), Brian R. Niccol, chairman and chief executive officer of Starbucks, and Rachel Ruggeri, executive vice president, chief financial officer of Starbucks, each hereby certifies, pursuant to 18 U.S.C.
L8: Section 1350, as adopted pursuant to Section 906 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, that, to their knowledge:
L9: 
L10: 
L11: (1)the Report fully complies with the requirements of Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934; and
L12: 
L13: (2)the information contained in the Report fairly presents, in all material respects, the financial condition and results of operations of Starbucks.
